fusions.name: Designator Beam
fusions.desc: Fires a lens-focused beam that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Failure Analysis
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, up to 8 tiles away. Fires a shot that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Spotter Drone
fusions.desc: Launches a spotter that calls your shots. Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds, and for 8 seconds the spotter fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Firing Solution
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
